integrity.analytical_basis: Reversible-square Kolmogorov products imply edge symmetry and equal target-normalized coefficients; explicit stationary weights prove sufficiency.
integrity.claim_scope: Exact reversible/irreversible classification, stationary product weights, factorized normalizer, uniform-network Bell-number classification and minimal nonreversible path; no independence or publication status claimed.
integrity.finite_verification: Rational-arithmetic exhaustive graph test n=1..5 and six-site weighted example; not substituted for unrestricted proof.

limitations: Finite-state continuous-time SIS network with strictly positive external infection and recovery rates; infection rates additive in infected-neighbor contributions. Necessity uses these positivity and additivity assumptions.
No claim of reversibility for nonlinear contact rates, zero-immigration chains, or nonlinear/state-dependent recovery.

Primary 2012 publication full text inaccessible; novelty comparison to its available abstract cannot exclude an unreported equivalent theorem; equivalent results under other stochastic-process terminology remain possible.
title: Reversibility of spontaneous SIS epidemics: a weighted clique classification
